messages.subject: Error in unmarkedMultFrame
parts:
Hello group,

Thank you in advance for your response.

I have this error:

Error in model.frame.default(psiformula, siteCovs, na.action = NULL) : 
  invalid type (list) for variable 'Flood'

Below is how I am reading my data into the unmarkedMultFrame.  The data frame is created without any troubles, but when I go to run a model that has a yearly site covariate in it, I get the aforementioned error.  
I have attached a printscreen of my unmarkedMultFrame, if that helps.

soray <- data.frame(read.csv("soradethist2013a.csv", header=T, row.names=c(1)))
SiteCov <- data.frame(read.csv("sitecovs.csv", header=T, row.names=c(1)))

Year <- data.frame(read.csv("year.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Flood <- data.frame(read.csv("flood2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Depth <- data.frame(read.csv("depth2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Height <- data.frame(read.csv("height2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Ow <- data.frame(read.csv("ow2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Emerge <- data.frame(read.csv("emerge2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
IntCov <- data.frame(read.csv("inter2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Shrub <- data.frame(read.csv("shrub2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Agric <- data.frame(read.csv("agric2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Duration <- data.frame(read.csv("duration2013fix.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Depth <- data.frame(read.csv("depth2013a.csv", row.names=c(1)))
YearlySiteCovariates <- list(Year, Flood, Depth, Height, Ow, Emerge, IntCov, 
                             Shrub, Agric, Duration, Depth)
names(YearlySiteCovariates) <- c("Year", "Flood", "Depth", "Height", "Ow", "Emerge", 
                                 "IntCov", "Shrub", "Agric", "Duration", "Depth")

Obs <- data.frame(read.csv("obs.csv", row.names=c(1)))
Start <- data.frame(read.csv("start.csv", header=T, row.names=c(1)))
Sky <- data.frame(read.csv("sky.csv", header=T, row.names=c(1)))
Wind <- data.frame(read.csv("wind.csv", header=T, row.names=c(1)))
Noise <- data.frame(read.csv("noise.csv", header=T, row.names=c(1)))
ObserverCovariates <- list(Obs, Start, Sky, Wind, Noise)
names(ObserverCovariates) <- c("Obs", "Start", "Sky", "Wind", "Noise")


soraumf <- unmarkedMultFrame(y = as.matrix(soray), 
                             siteCovs = SiteCov, 
                             yearlySiteCovs=YearlySiteCovariates,
                             obsCovs=ObserverCovariates, numPrimary=6)

P.S. I believe that I am reading everything correctly, because in the past when I was not reading the data into the unmarkedMultFrame correctly, I could not even create it.  This time, I can create it, but I am unable to run any models that have yearly site covariates.

Thank you for assistance,

Evan

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Error in unmarkedMultFrame
parts:
Dear Hill,

the way the standard dynamic occupancy model is parameterised, you cannot put something that varies as a covariate on psi.

psi is the occupancy in the first year. All the other psi's in the following years are functions of the first-year psi and the parameters for the dynamics. Only on these latter can you put yearly varying site covariates. If you want to model annually varying occupancy, then you have to do this in a different parameterisation of the model, one which is not available in unmarked. May be in PRESENCE or MARK. Or code that simpler model without explicit dynamics in BUGS.

Regards  --  Marc
